params.home_field_estimation_method: Team fixed-effect regression on non-neutral home margins
params.srs_solver: Direct least-squares solve with average-zero constraint
params.elo_home_field_conversion: 25 Elo points per 1 point of estimated HFA

sosMethod.method: Mean opponent SRS per scheduled game
sosMethod.opponents: Includes synthetic FCS buckets using their calculated SRS; repeated opponents count once per game.

sorMethod.method: Estimated Strength of Record; lower benchmark match-or-exceed probability ranks better
sorMethod.benchmark: Mean full-precision SRS of the top 25 FBS teams; shared across every schedule
sorMethod.validation_caveat: Final-season SRS is used throughout; fit diagnostics are not independent predictive validation.
sorMethod.assumptions: Independent games; fixed team strength; actual played schedules including repeats and synthetic FCS opponents. Synthetic buckets are not ranked. Ties rejected. Zero wins gives probability 1. Competition ranks compare probabilities rounded to 12 decimals.

effMethod.model: points scored = mu + offence + defence + home field
effMethod.home_field_source: Taken from the ratings export, not re-estimated, so this decomposition and the published SRS rest on the same figure.
effMethod.solver: Alternating least squares (Gauss-Seidel on the normal equations), offence and defence recentred on zero each sweep
effMethod.pace: Per game, not per drive. No national screen carries punts or field-goal attempts, so a league-wide drive count cannot be built from the source set. Football drives also vary far less than basketball possessions: the three dynasty schools run 10.4 to 11.8 a game.
